title: Automation
description: An automation definition representing a sequence of operations executed against Jira and/or Confluence in response to triggers.

description.description: Detailed description of what this automation does (optional)

triggers.description: Array of triggers (cron, webhook, manual). If omitted, automation is manual-only.

steps.description: Sequence of steps to execute. Must have at least one step.

automationSecret.description: Reference to Vault secret containing Jira/Confluence credentials (e.g., 'vault://jira-creds-prod'). Credentials are never stored in-line.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when automation was created (server-generated)

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when automation was last modified (server-generated)

createdBy.description: User ID or email of automation creator (server-generated)

lastModifiedBy.description: User ID or email of last modifier (server-generated)
